name: Camp Sangamon For Boys
description_short: Overnight camp for boys on a 200-acre hill farm with a spring-fed lake in Pittsford, Vermont, near Rutland and Killington. Campers live in cabins and do outdoor pursuits, aquatics, farming, creative arts and sports. In 2027 families book two-, three-, four- or five-week stays between June 27 and August 14.
refund_policy_summary: Deposit is $350 with the application, or $500 for early enrollment by December 31, which takes 3% off with the balance due March 1. Otherwise half the balance is due June 1 and the rest on arrival. Siblings get 3% off each child. If camp can't safely open, everything is refunded. Withdraw after March 15 and before May 1 and all payments beyond the deposit come back; no refunds after May 1.
